newsitem.title: USA: Hussein expected to meet Clinton on Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Hussein expected to meet Clinton on Tuesday.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein is still expected to meet U.S. President Bill Clinton in Washington on Tuesday, the White House said on Thursday.
"As far as we know, and we have confirmed with the Jordanians, the trip is still on," said White House spokesman Eric Rubin. "He has not cancelled."

Earlier on Thursday a Jordanian official told Israel radio Hussein would delay the visit to the United States following the fatal shooting of seven Israeli schoolgirls by a Jordanian soldier near the Israel-Jordan border.
